items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce, named StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks started on September 4th, 2026, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Hotfix for CVE-2026-75650)
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update (hotfix VULN-39341) for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to address CVE-2026-75650, an actively exploited vulnerability leading to arbitrary code execution. This hotfix is separate from the regular September security update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, allows an unauthenticated attacker to take over a customer account with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released isolated patch files for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing seven vulnerabilities, including the critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362). Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
